title: My love within a Golden Frame
author: Nilima Bora
text:
Slowly, the palette of Life
Has begun to fade ,
What I hold dear ,
Nestled in the depths of my heart ,
I`ve cradled with utmost care .

Occasionally, Unknowingly,
If unfurls transforming into a
vast canvas.
Resembling the expanse of the sky .
Within it , like colourful patterns ,
resides affection,
A Cosmos of planets and stars !

I enfold this canvas once again.
But can love ever be confined ?

They shimmer with an eternal rhythm,
Resembling the celestial canvas of night.
Capsuled within a golden frame ,
In the image of my beloved,
Clad in a black coat and red tie ,
Wearing a smile that graces his face .

Where love takes the from of Butterflies.
The boundaries of my affection.,
Break free from the confines
Of the golden Frame.
Galloping away like warhorses,
With reins being tugged and whipped.

It takes considerable effort to pacify.
To rein in the untamed spirit ,
Yet , persistently,
I confine love within its bounds,
like Parrot in a cage.
Clipping the wings,
restricting there flight .
